mode.label: Drop mode
mode.description: "only" cancels the server's own drops (equipment, gems, flasks and its own currency), so only the items below drop.

rarities.label: Monster rarities
rarities.description: Which kills drop the items below. None chosen means every monster.

items.label: Items per kill
items.description: Item name or metadata id: how many every kill drops. A fraction is the chance of one more (0.05 is 5%, 2.5 is two and a half). 0 removes it.

monsters.label: Only these monsters
monsters.description: Leave empty for every monster. Otherwise the variety id or the name must contain one of these (case does not matter), e.g. Doedre or AtlasBosses.
